changed: More shift and slide lines from The Caller's Box now import as figures instead of text. "Men shift right to next man's position" and "Women shift right one step" become a shift, and "Shift left to N2" and "Shift left with neighbor" become a slide along the set, each keeping the destination as the figure's note. "Re-check unrecognized figures" reads these lines in dances imported earlier, one line at a time, so a slide written straight after a wave balance is joined into a Rory O'More only when you import the dance again.

"Men slide right (past M)" straight after a wave balance in a Caller's Box dance now imports as a Rory O'More in which the men slide two places. A dance imported earlier picks this up when you import it again.
The figure parser keeps a shift's or bare slide's destination tail as the note; The Caller's Box adapter folds a one-group slide after a balance-wave line into `rory_o_more` with `twoPlaces`.
